narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='c1'/>The answer is eigh cubed plus b cubed. Multiply first with first, and last with last.
<bookmark mark='c2'/>Test his answer with eigh as one and b as two.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>The question gives three times nine, which is twenty seven. His answer gives one plus eight, only nine.
<bookmark mark='c4'/>He has dropped the middle terms, so the answer is wrong.
